info.name: MediQueue Auto Seed 100
info.description: Coleccion automatica para poblar MediQueue via API Gateway. Crea pacientes, dentistas, slots, citas y pagos; valida notificaciones generadas por eventos. No crea notificaciones manualmente.

exec: pm.test('Gateway health is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { console.error('Gateway is not healthy. Stop collection.'); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const stamp = String(Date.now());
pm.collectionVariables.set('runStamp', stamp);
['patientIndex','dentistIndex','slotIndex','appointmentIndex','paymentIndex','payment409Count'].forEach(k => pm.collectionVariables.set(k, '0'));
['patientIds','dentistIds','slotIds','slotPayloads','appointmentIds','paymentIds'].forEach(k => pm.collectionVariables.set(k, '[]'));

['patientNumber','patientNumberPadded','dentistNumber','dentistNumberPadded','currentPatientId','currentDentistId','currentSlotId','currentSlotDate','currentStartTime','currentEndTime','currentAppointmentId','currentPaymentId','firstPatientId','firstDentistEmail','waitCycle'].forEach(k => pm.collectionVariables.unset(k));
console.log('MediQueue Auto Seed runStamp=' + stamp);
postman.setNextRequest('01 - Create Patient Loop');
const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIndex') || 0);
const n = i + 1;
const padded = String(n).padStart(4, '0');
pm.collectionVariables.set('patientNumber', String(n));
pm.collectionVariables.set('patientNumberPadded', padded);
pm.collectionVariables.set('currentPatientEmail', `patient${n}.${pm.collectionVariables.get('runStamp')}@mediqueue.test`);
const body = pm.response.text();
pm.test('Patient create status 200/201', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('No 503 and no Redis error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(503); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('RedisConnectionFailureException'); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('LettuceConnectionException'); });
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Patient create failed', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json();
const id = json.patientId || json.id;
if (!id) { console.error('Patient response did not include patientId/id', json); postman.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Missing patientId'); }
const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]'); ids.push(id); pm.collectionVariables.set('patientIds', JSON.stringify(ids));
if (ids.length === 1) pm.collectionVariables.set('firstPatientId', id);
let i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIndex') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('patientIndex', String(i));
console.log(`Created patient ${i}/` + pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPatients') + ': ' + id);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPatients')) ? '01 - Create Patient Loop' : '02 - Create Dentist Loop');
const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIndex') || 0); const n = i + 1; const padded = String(n).padStart(3, '0');
pm.collectionVariables.set('dentistNumber', String(n)); pm.collectionVariables.set('dentistNumberPadded', padded);
pm.collectionVariables.set('currentDentistEmail', `dentist${n}.${pm.collectionVariables.get('runStamp')}@mediqueue.test`);
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Dentist create status 200/201', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('No 503 and no Redis error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(503); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('RedisConnectionFailureException'); });
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Dentist create failed', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.dentistId || json.id; if (!id) { console.error('Missing dentistId/id', json); postman.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Missing dentistId'); }
const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds') || '[]'); ids.push(id); pm.collectionVariables.set('dentistIds', JSON.stringify(ids));
if (ids.length === 1) pm.collectionVariables.set('firstDentistEmail', pm.collectionVariables.get('currentDentistEmail'));
let i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIndex') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('dentistIndex', String(i));
console.log(`Created dentist ${i}/` + pm.collectionVariables.get('totalDentists') + ': ' + id);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalDentists')) ? '02 - Create Dentist Loop' : '03 - Create Slot Loop');
const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIndex') || 0); const dentists = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds') || '[]');
if (dentists.length === 0) { throw new Error('No dentists available for slot creation'); }
const dentistId = dentists[i % dentists.length]; const dayOffset = Math.floor(i / 10); const slotInDay = i % 10;
const date = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 6, 1 + dayOffset)); const slotDate = date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const startMinutes = 8 * 60 + slotInDay * 30; const endMinutes = startMinutes + 30;
function hm(total) { return String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0') + ':00'; }

pm.collectionVariables.set('currentDentistId', dentistId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentSlotDate', slotDate); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentStartTime', hm(startMinutes)); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentEndTime', hm(endMinutes));
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Slot create status 200/201', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('No 503 and no Redis error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(503); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('RedisConnectionFailureException'); });
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Slot create failed', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.slotId || json.id; if (!id) { console.error('Missing slotId/id', json); postman.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Missing slotId'); }
const slotIds = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIds') || '[]'); slotIds.push(id); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotIds', JSON.stringify(slotIds));

const payloads = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotPayloads') || '[]'); payloads.push({ slotId: id, dentistId: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentDentistId'), slotDate: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentSlotDate'), startTime: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentStartTime'), endTime: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentEndTime') }); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotPayloads', JSON.stringify(payloads));

let i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIndex') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('slotIndex', String(i)); console.log(`Created slot ${i}/` + pm.collectionVariables.get('totalSlots') + ': ' + id);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalSlots')) ? '03 - Create Slot Loop' : '04 - Create Appointment Loop');

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIndex') || 0); const patients = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]'); const slots = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotPayloads') || '[]');
if (!patients[i] || !slots[i]) { throw new Error('Missing patient or slot for appointment index ' + i); }

const slot = slots[i]; pm.collectionVariables.set('currentPatientId', patients[i]); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentDentistId', slot.dentistId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentSlotId', slot.slotId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentSlotDate', slot.slotDate); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentStartTime', slot.startTime); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentEndTime', slot.endTime); pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentNumber', String(i + 1));
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Appointment create status 200/201/202', function () { pm.expect([200,201,202]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('No 503 and no Redis error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(503); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('RedisConnectionFailureException'); });

if (![200,201,202].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Appointment create failed; stopping because every slot should be unique', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }

const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.appointmentId || json.id; if (!id) { console.error('Missing appointmentId/id', json); postman.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Missing appointmentId'); }
const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]'); ids.push(id); pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentIds', JSON.stringify(ids));

let i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIndex') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentIndex', String(i)); console.log(`Created appointment ${i}/` + pm.collectionVariables.get('totalAppointments') + ': ' + id);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalAppointments')) ? '04 - Create Appointment Loop' : '05 - Create Payment Loop');

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentIndex') || 0); const appointments = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]'); const patients = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]');
if (!appointments[i] || !patients[i]) { throw new Error('Missing appointment or patient for payment index ' + i); }
pm.collectionVariables.set('currentAppointmentId', appointments[i]); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentPatientId', patients[i]);
const body = pm.response.text(); const ok = [200,201,202,409].includes(pm.response.code); pm.test('Payment status 200/201/202 or controlled 409', function () { pm.expect(ok).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('No 503 and no Redis error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.equal(503); pm.expect(body).to.not.include('RedisConnectionFailureException'); });
if (!ok) { console.error('Payment failed unexpectedly', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }

if (pm.response.code === 409) { const c = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('payment409Count') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('payment409Count', String(c)); console.warn('Controlled payment 409 for appointment ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('currentAppointmentId')); }

if ([200,201,202].includes(pm.response.code) && body) { const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.paymentId || json.id; if (id) { const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentIds') || '[]'); ids.push(id); pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentIds', JSON.stringify(ids)); } }

let i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentIndex') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentIndex', String(i)); console.log(`Attempted payment ${i}/` + pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPayments') + ' status=' + pm.response.code);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPayments')) ? '05 - Create Payment Loop' : '06 - Async Wait For Notifications');
const waitMs = 5000; const until = Date.now() + waitMs; while (Date.now() < until) {}
console.log('Waited ' + waitMs + ' ms for async RabbitMQ notification processing');
pm.test('Gateway still healthy while waiting', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let cycle = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waitCycle') || 0) + 1; pm.collectionVariables.set('waitCycle', String(cycle));
postman.setNextRequest(cycle < 3 ? '06 - Async Wait For Notifications' : '07 - Verify First Patient');
pm.test('First patient can be read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
console.log('Patient sample', pm.response.json());
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify First Dentist By Email');
pm.test('First dentist can be read by email', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
console.log('Dentist sample', pm.response.json());
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify Slots Available');
pm.test('Slots available endpoint returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const json = pm.response.json(); console.log('Available slots count returned=' + (Array.isArray(json) ? json.length : 'not-array'));
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify Appointments By First Patient');
pm.test('Appointments by patient returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const json = pm.response.json(); console.log('Appointments for first patient=' + (Array.isArray(json) ? json.length : 'not-array'));
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify Payments Page');
pm.test('Payments page returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const json = pm.response.json(); console.log('Payments totalElements=' + json.totalElements + ' content=' + (json.content ? json.content.length : 'n/a') + ' controlled409=' + pm.collectionVariables.get('payment409Count'));
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify Notifications Page');
pm.test('Notifications page returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const json = pm.response.json(); if (!json.totalElements || json.totalElements === 0) { console.warn('No notifications visible yet. This can depend on payment results and async consumers.'); } else { console.log('Notifications totalElements=' + json.totalElements); }
postman.setNextRequest('07 - Verify Notifications By First Patient');
pm.test('Notifications by first patient returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const json = pm.response.json(); if (!json.totalElements || json.totalElements === 0) { console.warn('No notifications for first patient yet; events may be async or payment result may not emit expected notification.'); } else { console.log('Notifications for first patient=' + json.totalElements); }
postman.setNextRequest('08 - Redis Evidence Commands');

item.name: 08 - Redis Evidence Commands
item.description:
Run these PowerShell commands after the collection finishes:

```powershell
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli DBSIZE
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli INFO keyspace
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --scan
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --scan --pattern "patients::*"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --scan --pattern "slots::*"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --scan --pattern "*k6*"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --scan --pattern "*request*"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli INFO stats
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli INFO stats | findstr "total_commands_processed keyspace_hits keyspace_misses total_error_replies"

docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli TYPE "KEY"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli TTL "KEY"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli --raw GET "KEY"
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli MEMORY USAGE "KEY"
```

Use MONITOR only for a few seconds because it is noisy:

```powershell
docker compose exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH=redis123 redis redis-cli MONITOR
```

exec: pm.test('Redis evidence placeholder health 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

console.log('Auto seed completed. Patients=' + JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]').length + ', dentists=' + JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds') || '[]').length + ', slots=' + JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIds') || '[]').length + ', appointments=' + JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]').length + ', payments=' + JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentIds') || '[]').length + ', payment409=' + pm.collectionVariables.get('payment409Count'));
postman.setNextRequest(null);
